Northrop Grumman is a leading company in technology and innovation, and they are seeking an Associate Software Engineer/Software Engineer to join their Software Engineering directorate. The role involves designing, developing, documenting, testing, and debugging applications software and systems, while collaborating with hardware engineers to create effective electronic data processing systems.

Determine computer user needs
Analyze system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls
Prepare operating instructions
Design and develop compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems
Ensures software standards are met
